svg.title: Penetration-test engagement: decisions, owners, and handoffs (provisional v0.1)
svg.desc: Three-lane map of a penetration-test engagement. Left lane: target owner and authorizing authority. Middle lane: testing practice. Right lane: vulnerability management and local risk authority. Steps: 1 select the target; 2 intake; 3 name the engagement owner; 4 scope and rules of engagement, sent to the left lane where the accountable target or risk owner authorizes testing in writing (Q1); 5 confirm readiness and notify stakeholders; 6 test and capture evidence, with an urgent-condition route to local authority and a scope-change loop back to authorization; 7 review and finding decision by tester and qualified reviewer, where findings are accepted, rejected, merged, split, deferred for evidence, or reported inconclusive (Q2), with a disputed-finding loop back to testing; 8 report and closing conversation, where the target owner may dispute a finding (loop back to step 7) and where one tested instance does not set enterprise-wide remediation: broader patterns and critical or high conditions route to local stakeholders under local authority; 9 the testing practice hands accepted findings to the issue record (Q3); vulnerability management sets priority and deadline and assigns the target owner; the target owner remediates, and deferral or risk acceptance is decided by the local risk authority; 10 retest returns to the testing practice (Q4), with a loop back to remediation when not fixed or inconclusive, and the result updates the issue record; 11 the practice closes and archives the engagement record and feeds lessons back to selection, while issue closure stays with vulnerability management and the target owner. Each step names the record it should leave behind. No fixed timelines, tools, or organizations are implied.
svg.text: Penetration-test engagement: decisions, owners, and handoffs
Provisional public map · organization-neutral · roles, not people · each step names the record it leaves behind
Not a deployment claim, a conformance standard, or permission to test. Owners, systems, and timelines are set locally.

Provisional v0.1 public derivative of a controlled engagement-flow diagram (v3.0). Not a deployment, conformance, or permission-to-test claim.
Timelines, tools, systems of record, retention, and staffing are local bindings recorded in an adopter's profile.
